record.name: SlideAI Pro: AI Presentation
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
【One line of text, or a pasted document. AI designs the whole deck from scratch.】

SlideAI Pro turns text into presentations (PDF / PowerPoint).
v15 rebuilds the generation engine from the ground up. Instead of filling templates, a designer-grade AI designs every deck individually: typography, colors, composition and diagrams that fit your topic.

■ Type it, or paste it
• One line (e.g. "The largest planets of the Solar System, 9th grade") → a complete deck, structure included
• Paste a report, article or meeting notes → formatted faithfully, every fact kept
• No settings, no toggles. Pasted text is detected automatically

■ Diagrams that explain, not decorate
• Comparisons side by side, processes as arrows, timelines on an axis, numbers big. One message per slide
• Photos generated to match each slide
• No recycled layouts or colors: every deck looks different

■ Editable PowerPoint, same look
• "Export PPTX" keeps the design exactly as you see it
• Text, tables and photos are exported as editable layers, ready for your own touches
• View and share PDFs right in the app

■ Fix it in words, or by hand
• "Edit with AI": say what to change, like "Make the timeline one slide and add 2019"
• "Direct Edit": replace wording and images yourself

■ Takes a few minutes. Worth it
Building a deck takes a few minutes. Close the app if you like; the finished deck lands in History.

■ 34 languages
The app speaks 34 languages. Decks are generated in your device language, or in the language of the text you pasted.

■ Made for
• Lessons, teaching materials and class presentations (students, teachers, researchers)
• Proposals, pitches and internal reports
• Turning an article or your notes into something you can present

No more staring at a blank slide. Write one line, and the deck is done.

Turn any idea into a complete, professional presentation in seconds. Just type one prompt and PresentAI generates a fully designed slide deck — structured content, polished layouts, and stunning visuals — ready to present or export.

Whether you need a pitch deck for investors, a quarterly business report, or a classroom lecture, PresentAI handles everything from outline to final slide. No design skills. No blank-slide anxiety. Just your idea and a tap.

One-Prompt Slide Generation
Describe your topic and PresentAI builds an entire deck for you — intelligent content, logical structure, and professional design in one step. Go from a single sentence to a complete presentation in under a minute.

Built-In Slide Editor
Fine-tune every detail after generation. Edit text, swap images, rearrange slides, and adjust layouts directly inside the app. Full creative control without leaving your phone.

AI-Powered Visuals
Every slide comes with contextually relevant images and graphics chosen by AI. Your presentations look polished and professional without hours of searching for the right visuals.

Infographics & Data Visualization
Transform complex data, statistics, and processes into clear visual stories. PresentAI creates charts, comparisons, timelines, and infographics that make your numbers speak.

Business Plan & Strategy Decks
Illustrate market analyses, growth projections, competitive landscapes, and roadmaps with sophisticated visual elements that bring your strategy to life.

Multiple Export Options
Save and share your presentations as images or export to PowerPoint and Google Slides. Present directly from your device or collaborate with your team on any platform.

Built for Everyone Who Presents
Entrepreneurs crafting investor pitches. Students preparing research projects. Marketers building campaign proposals. Executives running board meetings. Educators designing lesson materials. Remote teams creating consistent branded decks. PresentAI works for all of them.

Why PresentAI?
Other tools give you a blank canvas and expect you to be a designer. PresentAI gives you a finished deck and lets you make it yours. It is the fastest path from idea to presentation — beautifully designed, intelligently structured, and ready to impress.

Download PresentAI and stop spending hours on slides. Start presenting in seconds.

- Presentations, Education & Events: International symposia, business negotiations, trade shows, online roadshows, training sessions, campus lectures, and product demos.
- Individuals: Expat professionals, international students in classes and discussions, freelancers, and travelers needing cross-border communication.

- Advanced AI speech translation models optimized for low latency and high-quality live communication.

- Presentation Mode lets one host share live translation with an audience, while each participant chooses their own language.

Whether it's formal business, academic discussions, a live presentation, or day-to-day travel, Transync AI provides a reliable, accurate, and intelligent translation experience.
